metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in New Mexico higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collections: MODIS LST daily (MODIS/061/MOD11A1 Terra, and MYD11A1 Aqua) to ensure robust coverage.
- Dates: 2016-07-20 to 2016-07-28 (end-exclusive). Baseline: 2001-2010 for day-of-year 201-208 (Jul 20–27).
- Location: New Mexico boundary from TIGER/2018/States.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use QC_Day bits 0-1 == 00 (good quality) to mask LST_Day_1km.
- Convert to Celsius (scale 0.02, Kelvin to C).
- Compute valid pixel counts and coverage as proxy for cloud/invalid masking impact.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty: C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0: C2.
- If regional mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range [-50, 80] C: C3.
- Otherwise compare means: 2016 > baseline => A; else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const nmFeature = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States').filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'New Mexico')).first();
    const nmGeom = ee.Feature(nmFeature).geometry();
    const start2016 = '2016-07-20';
    const end2016 = '2016-07-28'; // end-exclusive

    // 2. Helpers
    const scale = 2000;
    function maskMOD11(img) {
      const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      const good = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // bits 0-1 == 00
      const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(good).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).rename('LST_C');
      return lstC.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    function getCol(sensorId, start, end, geom) {
      return ee.ImageCollection(sensorId).filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end).map(maskMOD11);
    }

    // 3. Collections: 2016 and Baseline (2001-2010 same DOY), using Terra + Aqua merged
    const col2016 = getCol('MODIS/061/MOD11A1', start2016, end2016, nmGeom)
      .merge(getCol('MODIS/061/MYD11A1', start2016, end2016, nmGeom));

    const baseTerra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
      .filterBounds(nmGeom).filterDate('2001-01-01', '2010-12-31')
      .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(201, 208)).map(maskMOD11);
    const baseAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1')
      .filterBounds(nmGeom).filterDate('2001-01-01', '2010-12-31')
      .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(201, 208)).map(maskMOD11);
    const baseCol = baseTerra.merge(baseAqua);

    const size2016 = await col2016.size().getInfo();
    const sizeBase = await baseCol.size().getInfo();

    if (!size2016 || !sizeBase) {
      console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016 || 0}`);
      console.log(`2001-2010 Images: ${sizeBase || 0}`);
      console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Mean images and valid pixel coverage
    const img2016 = col2016.mean();
    const imgBase = baseCol.mean();

    const totalCount = await ee.Image(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: nmGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('ones').getInfo();

    const valid2016 = await img2016.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: nmGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    const validBase = await imgBase.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: nmGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    const v2016 = (valid2016 === null || valid2016 === undefined) ? 0 : valid2016;
    const vBase = (validBase === null || validBase === undefined) ? 0 : validBase;

    if (totalCount === null || totalCount === 0 || v2016 === 0 || vBase === 0) {
      console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}`);
      console.log(`2001-2010 Images: ${sizeBase}`);
      console.log(`Total Pixels (2km): ${totalCount || 0}`);
      console.log(`Valid Pixels 2016: ${v2016} (cloud ~${totalCount ? ((1 - v2016 / totalCount) * 100).toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%)`);
      console.log(`Valid Pixels Baseline: ${vBase} (cloud ~${totalCount ? ((1 - vBase / totalCount) * 100).toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%)`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking for one or both periods.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Regional mean LST for both periods
    const mean2016 = await img2016.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: nmGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    const meanBase = await imgBase.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: nmGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST_C').getInfo();

    const badNum = (x) => (x === null || x === undefined || Number.isNaN(x) || x < -50 || x > 80);
    if (badNum(mean2016) || badNum(meanBase)) {
      console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}`);
      console.log(`2001-2010 Images: ${sizeBase}`);
      console.log(`Mean LST 2016 (C): ${mean2016}`);
      console.log(`Mean LST 2001-2010 (C): ${meanBase}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const cloud2016 = ((1 - v2016 / totalCount) * 100);
    const cloudBase = ((1 - vBase / totalCount) * 100);
    const delta = mean2016 - meanBase;

    // 6. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}`);
    console.log(`2001-2010 Images: ${sizeBase}`);
    console.log(`Total Pixels (2km): ${totalCount}`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels 2016: ${v2016} (cloud ~${cloud2016.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels Baseline: ${vBase} (cloud ~${cloudBase.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Mean LST 2016 (C): ${mean2016.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Mean LST 2001-2010 (C): ${meanBase.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Delta (2016 - baseline) (C): ${delta.toFixed(1)}`);

    // 7. Final Answer
    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
